title: Deadwood
body:
Description

The Deadwood Tree is only found in the Desert on the island of Ferwater. It is identified by its small size and the lack of any leaves.

Once cut down, you can sell the log for ~$2 per stud. If you use the saw or a sander, you will create the sanded version of the wood which sells for $35 per stud.

Like any other material in the game, you can use logs and sanded Deadwood to complete schematics.

Trivia

  • Because of its tiny size, you often can saw the entire tree as soon as cut instantaneously.
  • Deadwood, called AshTree when used in a schematic, is one of the few trees to have its name completely changed. Not to be confused with the actual Ash tree.
  • The other trees that have a different name in a schematic are Oak, Ash, and Mysterious Mushroom.
